question: For sodium chlorate droplets at RH of about 11% and 28 C under the applied magnetic field, what share formed coffee rings and what was the average ring diameter?
rendered:
The document does not provide the exact share of coffee-ring deposits at RH of about 11% and 28°C under the applied magnetic field. However, it does provide the share of coffee-ring deposits at RH of about 11% and 28°C under zero-field conditions (Table 2). 

For RH ≈ 11%, under zero-field conditions, the share of coffee-ring deposits (ncr11 [%]) was 20.0% and the average coffee-ring diameter (dcr11 [mm]) was 2.25 ± 0.07 mm.

Under the applied magnetic field of (290 ± 5) mT at RH ≈ 11% and 28°C, the share of coffee-ring deposits (ncr11 [%]) was 20.0% and the average coffee-ring diameter (dcr11 [mm]) was 2.49 ± 0.04 mm.

The document does not provide information about the share of coffee-ring deposits under the applied magnetic field at RH of about 11% and 28°C.
